title: Brand mark · Accredited Program mark artwork versions
slide_intent: Teach designers to check a local program name as part of every color decision. Small text can lose clarity even when the symbol remains recognizable.
strategic_value: A coherent set of local masters can keep the program affiliation visible across one- and two-color production.
demonstration: The six color variants each include Program Name beneath the logotype. The reversed specimen presents all three elements in white on red.
practical_value: Select the prepared version for the background and check that the name, logotype and symbol reproduce together.

content_islands.spec: Use the same program wording for each example. Stack two-color, single-color and reversed versions in labeled cells.
